standard.license_number: Random letter + 7 random digits. You can click the calculator icon to calculate the number automatically.
standard.middle_name: Middle name is optional. You can leave it blank, or click the calculator to generate a random middle name.
standard.birth_date: Enter the date in month, day, year format: MMDDYYYY. Example: 01151970.
standard.issue_date: Public issue period is from October 20, 2025 until today. Click the calculator to generate a valid issue date in MMDDYYYY format.
standard.expiry_date: Enter expiry date in month, day, year format: MMDDYYYY. The calculator uses the issue date and adds five years.
standard.document_discriminator: First 8 digits are the issue date in DD/MM/YYYY format. The last 2 digits are the expiry year. You can click the calculator icon to calculate DD automatically.
standard.audit_info: First 2 digits are issue year. Next 3 digits are the day number in that year. Next numbers are document number plus 0401. Click the calculator icon to calculate ICN automatically.
standard.suffix: Name suffix is optional. Use NONE when there is no suffix.
standard.is_real_id: Select whether this record is marked as REAL ID.

mombasa.license_number: 7 random digits. You can click the calculator icon to calculate number automatically.
mombasa.expiry_date: Same month and day as in birth date. 5 years after the year of issue.
mombasa.audit_info: Document number + 5 random digits + 2 digits of issue year + 3 digits from the beginning of the year to document + 01. You can click the calculator icon to calculate ICN automatically.

kwale.license_number: One letter and 12 numbers. You can click the calculator icon to calculate number automatically.
kwale.expiry_date: Same month and day as in birth date. 4 years after the year of issue.
kwale.audit_info: Document number + '01' + number of days from the beginning of year to issue date + '01'. You can click the calculator icon to calculate ICN automatically.
kwale.document_discriminator: 7 zeros + 7 random digits. You can click the calculator icon to calculate DD automatically.

kilifi.license_number: 8 random digits. You can click the calculator icon to calculate number automatically.
kilifi.expiry_date: Same month and day as in birth date. 6 years after the issue year.
kilifi.document_discriminator: 20 digits with custom algorithm. Please click the calculator icon to calculate DD automatically.
kilifi.audit_info: '0000' + 7 random digits. You can click the calculator icon to calculate ICN automatically.

lamu.license_number: You can click on the calculator icon to calculate number automatically.
lamu.document_discriminator: 7 digits + whitespace + 3 digits + issue date (YYMMDD) + 3 letters + -1 or -0. You can click on the calculator icon to calculate DD automatically.
lamu.audit_info: 10 digits. You can click on the calculator icon to calculate ICN automatically.
lamu.expiry_date: As of January 2019, 8 years, expires on birthday in 7th or 8th year; previously issued cards, 5 years.
lamu.is_real_id: Select whether this record is marked as REAL ID.
